column1: # Mail names the build adds by hand (#486): names real address data writes as the city that the Census Gazetteer and the GeoNames ZIP
# places lack. Every name is a populated place in the GeoNames dump (https://download.geonames.org/export/geonames.org/ US.zip, the
# feature code is in `why`) and has 100 or more city-field rows in one of the real sources (counts in docs/places.md); a name that is
# also a whole street name more often than a city is left out (SANTA FE, CALIFORNIA; HARRISON, FLORIDA; CRESTVIEW, TEXAS). A row whose

# name is already a place only adds its variants (NEW YORK CITY is another name of NEW YORK). Columns: state, name, county, variants, why; the county is given where the parser needs it (the Queens house-number rule reads it, `place.rs`), from the GeoNames county code of the feature, and is empty elsewhere.
